policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Southwest Baptist drop first points, still outscore the division Southwest Baptist's perfect start is over after a home draw with Missouri-St. Louis. Their seventeen goals are still more than any other programme in the division has scored, and they carry that tally, and an unbeaten record, into the Great Lakes Valley Conference table.
